sloka: वसिष्ठस्य च ये शिष्याः ये च वै मृग पक्षिणः ।विद्रवन्ति भयात् भीता नाना दिक्भ्यः सहस्रशः ॥१-५५-२३॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya ca ye śiṣyāḥ ye ca vai mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ।vidravanti bhayāt bhītā nānā dikbhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥1-55-23॥

translations.english: The disciples of Vasishta as well as animals and birds got terrified by the fear and fled in their thousands in all directions.
